basic_details.short_information: Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC) Peon Notification 2026 has been released on 22 July 2026 on the official website of Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC). A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the TMC ACTREC Peon Recruitment 2026.

qualification.details: HSC Passed with one year experience in office work mandatory.

all_official_links.label: Download TMC ACTREC Peon Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Peon Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the TMC ACTREC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download TMC ACTREC Peon Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: HSC Passed with one year experience in office work mandatory.

content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Peon Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: TMC ACTREC Peon Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the post being recruited for?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for the post of Peon at the Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (TMC ACTREC).

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Peon post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The mode of application is through a Walk-in Interview. No online application is required.

faq.question: Q4. When is the Walk-in Interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled for 07 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the required qualification for the Peon post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed HSC and possess one year of experience in office work.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Peon post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 19,500/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q8. Where is the venue for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: The venue details will be available in the official notification. Candidates are advised to check the official website for precise location and reporting time.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates (if applicable).

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
